visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a studio with a lush, tropical plant background. Three people—a woman in a white blouse and black skirt in the center, a man in a white shirt and blue jeans to her right, and another man partially visible on the left—are dancing energetically. The woman and the man on the right each hold a blue book with a deity illustration, moving them rhythmically. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of a young woman with long brown hair in a ruffled white blouse. She hugs a blue book and a small black tripod, her eyes closed in a blissful smile. Animated pink hearts float around her against a soft, bright background. (3) Transition to an indoor interview setting. The woman sits on a gray sofa, holding the blue book while speaking with a sincere expression. Beside her, a man with short hair and white-rimmed glasses listens attentively. The lighting is warm and soft. (4) The woman is then seen outdoors, sitting cross-legged against a vibrant background of golden autumn leaves. She reads the blue book, which unfolds like an accordion to reveal vertical calligraphy on aged, textured paper. (5) Back in the interview, the man in glasses holds and examines the book. Close-ups focus on the intricate cover illustration of a traditional deity and the small, colored amber gems embedded along the top edge of the book. (6) The woman appears in a studio setting, holding a microphone with a 'Jing' logo and speaking directly to the camera. She maintains a calm and hopeful demeanor, holding the book throughout her speech. (7) A final montage shows the woman posing gracefully with the book in a white silk robe and the white blouse, alternating between peaceful reading and smiling at the camera, with golden text overlays appearing at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional piece for the 'Heart Sutra Lamp Book' co-branded by Beigang Chaotian Temple and Amber Felix. It uses a personal testimonial narrative from Lin Daiying to illustrate how spiritual faith and this specific religious item provided emotional stability and wisdom during a period of personal hardship, effectively targeting an audience looking for spiritual comfort and cultural significance.
